look: Trail map as the backing theme, phone in the middle showing steps and taps, and finish with the packing the bag. (Trail map: contour lines draw a route that leads the app screens upward. Phone in the field: one phone floats center while screens slide and taps ripple outward. Packing the bag: gear cards snap into a catalog grid like a pack being filled.)

scenes.name: The questions
scenes.desc: Over the site topo map, the questions every member gets about their gear pop in (Sound familiar?), then drop away as the line becomes Your gear catalog, made easy.

scenes.name: Sign up
scenes.desc: The caption carries over from the questions; a phone rises onto the summit; Continue with Google, the five application steps, and That’s everything we need.

scenes.name: Add a product
scenes.desc: Once approved, on the dashboard a retailer search finds the camera, a testimonial is typed, and it lands in My catalog.

scenes.name: Share it
scenes.desc: The catalog link goes out the two main ways: to a client after a trip, and to a friend who asks what to buy; each unfurls into the member share card.

scenes.name: Pack it up
scenes.desc: Gear cards drop into a backpack and the flap closes, then the end card with www.gearbook.shop; members’ faces pop in under the address with Join our first members.
